summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Next.js 14 HR Analytics application with MSW mocking. All core features working correctly including authentication, data tables, and protected routes.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation links don't properly update URL - clicking Sign In, Admin Dashboard, B2B Portal buttons loads content but URL remains at homepage
Sidebar navigation between Profile and Roles has intermittent issues - clicks don't always navigate properly

passed_tests: Homepage renders with HR Analytics branding and all navigation elements
B2C Login page renders with proper form elements
Admin Login page renders with dark theme left panel
Register page renders with name/email/password form
Forgot Password page renders and functions
Admin login flow: admin@admin.com/password → successful redirect to /users with toast
Users page displays DataTable with all mock users (Administrator, John Doe, Jane Smith, Alice Johnson)
Roles page displays DataTable with all mock roles (Super Administrator, HR Manager, B2B Partner, Employee)
Create Role dialog opens with permission tree and form elements
Profile page shows user details and edit form correctly
Middleware protection redirects unauthenticated users to admin login
Navbar user dropdown shows Profile/Logout options
MSW API mocking functions correctly for all endpoints
Authentication cookies and session management working
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix navigation issues: 1) Homepage navigation buttons should properly update URL when navigating to login pages, 2) Sidebar navigation between Profile and Roles needs to be more reliable
success_percentage: frontend: 85% - Core functionality working, minor navigation issues
